empty.title: No board loaded

empty.formats: Supported formats: Gerber RS-274X and X2, Excellon, drill data as Gerber (Proteus).
drop.hint: Drop the files to import them
layers.title: Project
layers.color: Display colour of the layer (no effect on machining)
layers.up: Move the layer up: it is drawn over the next one
layers.down: Move the layer down: it is drawn under the previous one
layers.remove: Remove the layer from the project
view.measureHint: Click two points to measure. Escape to stop.

about.title: About 8-CAM
about.body: PCB CAM software of 8 Fablab Drôme: from Gerber files to G-code, entirely in the browser.
about.reference: Algorithms inspired by FlatCAM Plus (MIT licence), rewritten in TypeScript.
about.privacy: No file is sent over the internet.
help.panelIntro: Every explanation of the buttons and parameters, grouped by topic. Hover or select an element of the interface to see its help in place.
help.viewFit.title: Show everything
help.viewFit.body: Centres the view and adjusts the zoom to show all visible layers in full.
help.viewFit.advice: Shortcuts: F key or double click in the view.
help.viewZoomIn.title: Zoom in
help.viewZoomIn.body: Enlarges the view around its centre. The mouse wheel zooms around the cursor, which is often handier.
help.viewZoomOut.title: Zoom out
help.viewZoomOut.body: Moves the view away to see a larger part of the board.
help.viewGrid.title: Grid
help.viewGrid.body: Shows a millimetre grid behind the board. The spacing follows the zoom (1, 2 or 5 times a power of 10); one line in five is stronger.
help.viewGrid.advice: Shortcut: G key. The current spacing is shown in the status bar.
help.viewOrigin.title: File origin
help.viewOrigin.body: Shows the zero of the Gerber file coordinates: pink line towards positive X, green line towards positive Y. This is not the machine origin yet, which is chosen at export.
help.viewMeasure.title: Measure a distance
help.viewMeasure.body: Click a first point, then a second one: the status bar shows the horizontal (Δx) and vertical (Δy) gaps and the distance in millimetres.
help.viewMeasure.advice: Zoom in before clicking for more precision. Escape or M to stop.
help.viewCursor.title: Cursor position
help.viewCursor.body: Coordinates of the board point under the mouse, in millimetres, in the Gerber file frame.
help.viewScale.title: Display scale
help.viewScale.body: Number of screen pixels for one millimetre of board. The larger it is, the more the view is zoomed in.
help.viewGridStep.title: Grid spacing
help.viewGridStep.body: Distance in millimetres between two thin grid lines, chosen automatically from the zoom.
help.fileOpen.title: Open files
help.fileOpen.body: Imports the Gerber (copper, outline…) and drill files (Excellon or Gerber) exported by your CAD software. You can pick several at once, or drop them on the window.
help.fileOpen.advice: Everything is computed in the browser: your files never leave your computer.
help.fileExample.title: Example board
help.fileExample.body: Loads the fablab FTDI_Max board (bottom copper and drills) to try the software without your own files.
help.layerVisibility.title: Show or hide
help.layerVisibility.body: Shows or hides the layer in the view. A hidden layer stays in the project.
help.layerColor.title: Display colour
help.layerColor.body: Colour used to draw the layer on screen. It only helps to find your way and has no effect on machining.
help.layerUp.title: Move the layer up
help.layerUp.body: Draws the layer over the one above it in the list. Layers at the top of the list hide those at the bottom.
help.layerDown.title: Move the layer down
help.layerDown.body: Draws the layer under the next one in the list.
help.layerRemove.title: Remove the layer
help.layerRemove.body: Removes the layer from the project. The file on your computer is untouched; you can import it again.
help.layerType.title: Layer type
help.layerType.body: Role of the file guessed at import: top or bottom copper, outline, drill… It comes from the X2 attributes of the file when present, otherwise from its name.
help.layerType.warning: An "Unknown" type means the file could not be recognised: check it is the layer you expect.
help.layerWarnings.title: Warnings
help.layerWarnings.body: Number of places of the file that caused trouble while reading (unknown command, guessed format…). The details, with line numbers, are under "Details".
help.layerWarnings.warning: A guessed coordinate format can shift or scale the board: check the holes against the copper.
help.importCancel.title: Cancel the import
help.importCancel.body: Stops reading the current file. Nothing is added to the project.
help.language.title: Language
help.language.body: Switches every text of the interface and of the help between French and English. The choice is remembered by this browser.
help.theme.title: Theme
help.theme.body: Look of the interface: automatic (follows the computer setting), light or dark. The board view stays dark so the layers stand out.
help.helpPanel.title: Help
help.helpPanel.body: Opens the help panel with every explanation grouped by topic.
help.about.title: About
help.about.body: Software version, licence and links to 8 Fablab Drôme.
help.diameter.title: Diameter
help.diameter.body: Width of the cutting part of the tool. For a V-bit, what matters is the actual width at the cutting depth, not the shank diameter.
help.diameter.advice: Measure it with a calliper or trust the maker's datasheet.
help.tipAngle.title: Tip angle (V-bit)
help.tipAngle.body: Angle of the tool cone. The smaller it is, the thinner the cut stays as the tool goes deeper.
help.tipAngle.warning: A wide angle quickly widens the cut if the board is not flat.
help.tipDiameter.title: Tip diameter (V-bit)
help.tipDiameter.body: Width of the flat at the end of the tool. It is the narrowest possible cut.
help.tipDiameter.warning: A broken tip makes the tool wider than advertised.
help.feedXY.title: XY feed rate
help.feedXY.body: Speed of the tool while cutting, in millimetres per minute.
help.feedXY.advice: 120 to 150 mm/min for isolation on a 3018 CNC.
help.feedXY.warning: Too fast: broken tool or burrs. Too slow: overheating.
help.feedZ.title: Z feed rate (plunge)
help.feedZ.body: Speed of the tool going down into the material, in millimetres per minute.
help.feedZ.advice: About a third of the XY feed rate.
help.spindleSpeed.title: Spindle speed
help.spindleSpeed.body: Rotation speed of the tool, in revolutions per minute.
help.cutDepth.title: Cutting depth
help.cutDepth.body: Distance below the copper surface reached by the tool. Copper is 35 µm thick: going through it is enough.
help.cutDepth.warning: Too deep = wider cut with a V-bit.
help.depthPerPass.title: Depth per pass
help.depthPerPass.body: Thickness removed at each pass. The total depth is reached in several passes.
help.depthPerPass.advice: 0.3 to 0.5 mm when cutting out FR4.
help.passes.title: Number of passes (isolation)
help.passes.body: Number of concentric outlines around the tracks. More passes = more space between tracks and the remaining copper.
help.overlap.title: Overlap
help.overlap.body: Share of the cutting width common to two neighbouring passes.
help.overlap.warning: At 0 %, a copper hair can remain between two passes.
help.millingDirection.title: Milling direction
help.millingDirection.body: Climb milling: the tool turns in the feed direction, better finish on a rigid machine. Conventional milling: more tolerant of mechanical backlash.
help.millingDirection.advice: Conventional is advised on hobby CNCs with backlash.
help.peck.title: Peck drilling
help.peck.body: The drill goes back up regularly to clear the chips.
help.peck.advice: Useful beyond 2 mm of depth, usually useless on 1.6 mm FR4.
help.tabs.title: Tabs
help.tabs.body: Small bridges of material left on the outline so the board does not come loose while machining.
help.tabs.advice: 2 to 4 tabs, 1 to 2 mm wide. Break them with pliers and sand them.
help.tabHeight.title: Tab height
help.tabHeight.body: Thickness of material left where the tabs are.
help.tabHeight.advice: About 0.5 mm on a 1.6 mm board.
help.cutoutMargin.title: Cutout margin
help.cutoutMargin.body: Extra distance between the board edge and the cut.
help.cutoutMargin.advice: 0 when an Edge.Cuts outline exists, 1 to 2 mm otherwise.
help.nonIsolated.title: Non isolated area
help.nonIsolated.body: Place where the tool is too wide to pass between two copper features. A short circuit is likely.
help.nonIsolated.advice: Choose a thinner tool or reduce the depth (V-bit).
help.travelZ.title: Travel height (travel Z)
help.travelZ.body: Height at which the tool moves between two cuts.
help.travelZ.advice: 1 to 2 mm, above clamps and fixtures.
help.safeZ.title: Safe height (safe Z)
help.safeZ.body: Retract height at the start, at the end and at tool changes.
help.safeZ.advice: 10 to 20 mm, always above travel Z.
help.origin.title: Origin
help.origin.body: Point of the board that matches the machine zero.
help.origin.advice: Bottom left corner: the easiest to set on the machine.
help.mirror.title: Mirror
help.mirror.body: Flips the geometry to machine the bottom side.
help.mirror.advice: Required for the back side of a double sided board.
help.postProcessor.title: Post-processor
help.postProcessor.body: Translates the toolpaths into the G-code dialect of the machine.
help.messageDismiss.title: Close the message
help.messageDismiss.body: Hides this error message. The file was not added to the project: you can import it again once corrected.
sg.title: Brand styleguide
sg.intro: Internal validation page: colours, fonts, components, stickers, help and patterns as implemented. Switch the theme to compare light and dark.
sg.contrastNote: Measured contrast ratio of the text on its background (WCAG AA: 4.5 for body text).
sg.titles: Bebas Neue: titles, sections, stickers, key figures (always in capitals)
sg.homeTitle: Home title slanted by −10° (home screen only)
sg.body: Karla: everything else in the interface, 300 to 800, with italics
sg.helptipsNote: Hover, select with the keyboard or long press these parameters. Parametric illustrations come with the parameters themselves (milestone J5 onwards).
sg.patternsNote: Two-colour patterns, only on the home screen, empty states and About, never behind dense text.
sg.calloutSuccess: The tool fits between all tracks.
sg.calloutWarning: Less than 10 % margin between the tool and the minimum clearance.
sg.calloutError: 3 areas cannot be isolated with this tool.
sg.calloutInfo: The coordinate format was read from the file.
sg.calloutHelp: Start with the board analysis to choose your tools.
